subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

She ventured to go back to the tree of the (__**tryst**__), the mulberry with the shining fruit.
solution:
The correct answer is "Separation."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "tryst" means an appointed meeting especially between lovers. (पूर्व निश्चित गुप्‍त भेंट (प्रायः प्रेमियों की); अभिसार)

 
 
• Example: *Let's plan a **tryst**__ at our favorite coffee shop tomorrow evening.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence is **"Separation."**
 
• The word "separation" means an agreement where a couple decide not to live together any more. (पति-पत्‍नी में अब साथ-साथ न रहने का समझौता)
 __
 
• Example:* During the war many couples had to endure long periods of **separation**__*.
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Rendezvous: **a meeting that you have arranged with somebody. (किसी के साथ तय हुई भेंट, पूर्व निश्चित भेंट)
 
• **Date: **a social meeting planned before it happens, especially one between two people who have or might have a romantic relationship. (एक सामाजिक बैठक होने से पहले योजना बनाई जाती है, विशेष रूप से दो लोगों के बीच, जिनके बीच रोमांटिक संबंध हैं या हो सकते हैं)
 
• **Engagement: **an agreement to get married; the time when you are engaged. (सगाई; सगाई की रस्‍म)
